name: Purv Flexipack Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2005, Purv Flexipack Ltd is in the business of distribution of various plastic-based product[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) PFL is a part of the Purv group which supplies raw materials to flexible plastic packaging sector. Company is in the business of chemical trading.
b) It is a del credere agent (DCA) of Indian Oil Corporation Ltd, supplying low-density polyethylene (LDPE), high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and polypropylene (PP) to West Bengal and Bihar. 
c) It is an authorized dealer of SRF  Ltd, supplying raw materials such as polyester film, metallized polyester film, biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) film and holographic polyester film for manufacturing speciality chemicals. 
d) PFL has taken distributorship of polyester and BOPP films of Jindal 
Poly Films Ltd 
e) It is involved in trading of plastic granules, masterbatch /colorants, films, ink and adhesives, titanium dioxide and ethyl acetate. The company is based in Kolkata.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.65% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.39.5 Cr.
